metadata.title: Daylight
metadata.description: Finish the daylight branch with lamps and a measured control circuit.

tracker.text: Place 8 redstone lamps along the gate road.

offer.label: Daylight
lines: The gate follows daylight. Now the road lamps should follow it too.
Set the lamps where the path bends and give the control box a way to compare weak light with strong.
Place 8 redstone lamps and bring 2 comparators and 12 quartz. I will make the reward worth the trouble.

started: Face every lamp toward the road. Lighting the roof helps only bats.
Place 8 redstone lamps and bring 2 comparators and 12 quartz.
Good. I will keep a place clear for what you bring back.

turn_in.label: About Daylight
lines: The road wakes at dusk and sleeps after dawn. No villager needs to remember the lever.
The sun now keeps the village lamps better than any watch schedule.
Let me see the full work before I close the note.
